outcome: timing of delivery (within 48h, 72h, or 96h) in PPROM cases
cohort: 292 pregnant women diagnosed with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) between 24 and 34 gestational weeks.
finding: Systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) and multi-inflammatory index (MII-1) demonstrated the highest predictive power for predicting delivery timing in PPROM cases, particularly for delivery within 96 hours.
